_readme: PREMIUM RESOURCES - DOWNLOADABLE COLLECTIONS ONLY
This file holds resource collections: worksheet packs, lesson-plan
collections, model-paper collections, revision packs and the like.
IT DOES NOT HOLD complete published books. Books and ebooks belong in
data/publications.json, which feeds the RCF Publications section. The
two are deliberately separate and must not be mixed.
A downloadable collection of worksheets      -> here
A complete book, formally published          -> publications.json
The list starts empty. No titles, prices, quantities or ratings have
been invented. Until you add real products each page shows a short
note instead of pretend items.
THE TWO CATEGORIES
Every product must set "category" to exactly one of:
student   Shown on Premium Resources > Student Resources
teacher   Shown on Premium Resources > English Teacher Resources
A product with any other value, or none, appears on neither page.
HOW TO ADD A RESOURCE
"id": "a-short-unique-name",
"code": "STU-001",
"category": "student",
"title": "The name of the pack",
"grade": "Grades 6-9",
"skill": "Grammar",
"resourceType": "Worksheets",
"quantity": "40 worksheets",
"audience": "Grades 6 to 9",
"description": "Two or three plain sentences.",
"format": "PDF",
"price": "Contact us for the current price",
"badge": "",
"buttonLabel": "View details",
"image": "",
"imageAlt": "",
"source": "RCF English",
"published": true
THE FIELDS
id            Short name, used only inside this file. Must be unique.
code          A product code such as STU-001 or TCH-001. It is printed
on the card and carried into the WhatsApp payment message,
so you can tell exactly what a buyer has paid for.
category      student | teacher   (see above)
title         The product name.
grade         Primary | Grades 6-9 | G.C.E. O/L | G.C.E. A/L |
General English. Used by the grade filter.
skill         Reading | Writing | Grammar | Vocabulary | Listening |
Speaking | Literature | Examination Practice.
Used by the skill filter.
resourceType  Lesson Plans | Worksheets | Model Papers | Revision Packs
| Classroom Activities | Assessment Resources |
Teacher Resources. Used by the type filter.
purpose       Teacher resources only. Teaching | Practice | Assessment
| Remedial Support | Revision | Teacher Development.
competency    Optional. A competency level such as '6.1' if the pack
maps to one.
quantity      How much is in it, e.g. '40 worksheets', '12 lesson
plans'. Leave empty rather than guessing.
audience      Free text shown on the card.
description   What it contains. Keep it factual.
format        PDF, editable Word, and so on.
price         Leave as 'Contact us for the current price' until you are
ready to publish a figure. Nothing is invented here.
badge         Leave empty, or one of: New | Popular | Special offer
url           A preview or details page. Leave empty if there is none.
image         Thumbnail path, e.g. downloads/premium/name.jpg
Thumbnails keep their proportions and are never cropped.
imageAlt      A short description, for screen readers.
source        Who produced it. 'RCF English' for your own work. For an
approved third-party product sold under a commission or
affiliate arrangement, name that seller here.
affiliate     Optional. true adds a plain note saying RCF English may
earn a commission.
published     false hides the product without deleting it.
